title: Nun Massacre
description: Hide from the KILLER Nun at all costs! She hungers for BLOOD and you are the next course! A letter has arrived at your house under mysterious circumstances... your daughter has fallen ill at her boarding school. As you make a trip to pick her up, a storm blows in and the road is blocked. You continue on foot through the woods and all hell soon breaks loose... -Stealth horror gameplay. It's a DEADLY game of Hide and Seek! -5th gen graphics. -Pick your preferred image format -There are multiple endings and secrets to unlock in the NUN'S nightmarish lair
